persons.name: Dhana
persons.evidence: bhāju dhana vyākaraṇaṃ prayogamukhaṃ lilekhādhyayanārtham eva

date.as_written: saṃ 883 jyeṣṭhaśuklayā ekāśi (!) somavāra ... guṇāhimātaṃgagate ca varṣe, jeṣṭhe śucau candradine hares tithau

notes: The chronogram 'guṇāhimātaṅga' corresponds to 3, 8, 8 = NS 883. Ekādaśī is designated by 'hares tithau'.
